SELECT d.diet_type_value
FROM Diets AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Nutritionists AS n
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Nutritionists_Diets AS nd
    WHERE nd.nutritionist_id = n.nutritionist_id
      AND nd.diet_type_id = d.diet_type_id
  )
)

SELECT streaming_service.name, customer_support.description
FROM streaming_service
JOIN streaming_service_customer_support
  ON streaming_service.id = streaming_service_customer_support.streaming_service_id
JOIN customer_support
  ON streaming_service_customer_support.customer_support_id = customer_support.id

SELECT ss.service_name, sm.type
FROM Streaming_Service AS ss
JOIN Streaming_Service_Social_Media AS sssm
  ON ss.id = sssm.streaming_service_id
JOIN Social_Media AS sm
  ON sssm.social_media_id = sm.social_media_id

SELECT ss.name, mm.model_name
FROM Streaming_Service AS ss
JOIN Streaming_Service_Monetization_Model AS ssmm
  ON ss.id = ssmm.streaming_service_id
JOIN Monetization_Model AS mm
  ON ssmm.monetization_model_id = mm.id

SELECT s.title, cs.language
FROM Streamings AS s
JOIN Streamings_captions_and_subtitles AS scs
  ON s.streaming_id = scs.streamings_id
JOIN Captions_and_subtitles AS cs
  ON scs.captions_and_subtitles_id = cs.caption_id

SELECT c.cuisine_name
FROM Cuisines AS c
JOIN Food_Critics_Cuisines AS fcc
  ON c.id = fcc.cuisine_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.cuisine_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fcc.food_critic_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Food_Critics
)

SELECT Ux_Designers.name, Components.description
FROM Ux_Designers
JOIN Ux_Designers_Components
  ON Ux_Designers.id = Ux_Designers_Components.ux_designer_id
JOIN Components
  ON Ux_Designers_Components.component_id = Components.id

SELECT e.end_date
FROM Elections AS e
JOIN Political_Reporters_Elections AS pre
  ON e.id = pre.election_id
GROUP BY e.id, e.end_date
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pre.reporter_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Political_Reporters
)

SELECT c.description
FROM Online_Learning_Platforms AS p
JOIN Online_Learning_Platforms_Courses AS pc
  ON p.platformID = pc.platformID
JOIN Courses AS c
  ON pc.courseID = c.courseID

SELECT cc.id, b.benefitName
FROM Credit_Cards AS cc
JOIN Credit_Card_Benefits AS ccb ON ccb.creditCardId = cc.id
JOIN Benefits AS b ON b.id = ccb.benefitId

SELECT t.name, f.description
FROM Terminals AS t
JOIN Terminals_Facilities AS tf ON t.id = tf.terminalId
JOIN Facilities AS f ON tf.facilityId = f.id

SELECT Art_Galleries.Name, Exhibitions.Description
FROM Art_Galleries
JOIN Art_Galleries_Exhibitions
  ON Art_Galleries.GalleryID = Art_Galleries_Exhibitions.GalleryID
JOIN Exhibitions
  ON Art_Galleries_Exhibitions.ExhibitionID = Exhibitions.ExhibitionID

SELECT ServiceName
FROM Services s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Hotels h
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Hotels_Services hs
        WHERE hs.Hotels_ID = h.HotelID
          AND hs.Service_ID = s.ServiceID
    )
)

SELECT h.name, a.amenityName
FROM Hotels AS h
JOIN Hotel_Amenities AS ha ON h.id = ha.hotelId
JOIN Amenities AS a ON ha.amenityId = a.amenityId

SELECT Health_Apps.name, Functions.value
FROM Health_Apps
JOIN Health_Apps_Functions
  ON Health_Apps.appID = Health_Apps_Functions.healthAppID
JOIN Functions
  ON Health_Apps_Functions.functionID = Functions.functionID

SELECT e.name
FROM Equipment AS e
JOIN Movie_sets_equipment AS mse
  ON e.id = mse.equipment_id
GROUP BY e.id, e.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mse.movie_set_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Movie_sets)

SELECT Degree_Level.level_name, COUNT(Job_Post.id)
FROM Job_Post
JOIN Degree_Level ON Job_Post.degree_level_id = Degree_Level.id
GROUP BY Degree_Level.id, Degree_Level.level_name

SELECT Movie.title, Movie.genre, Movie.release_year, Studio.name
FROM Movie
JOIN Studio ON Movie.studio_id = Studio.id

SELECT name, mean_commute_time
FROM Neighborhood
WHERE population < 10000

SELECT r.name, m.title, dg.group_name
FROM Readers AS r
JOIN Magazines AS m ON r.preferred_magazine_id = m.magazine_id
JOIN Demographic_Groups AS dg ON r.demographic_group_id = dg.id

SELECT Name, Official_Language
FROM Countries
ORDER BY Population ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT Name, Founding_Year
FROM Financial_Institutions
ORDER BY Total_Liabilities ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.PhoneNumber, c.AddressLine
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Tickets AS t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN Concerts AS co ON t.ConcertID = co.ConcertID
JOIN Artists AS a ON co.HeadlineArtistID = a.ArtistID
WHERE a.Genre = 'Pop'

SELECT Costume_Designer, Costumes
FROM Costumes
WHERE Budget < 750000

SELECT DISTINCT Topic.name
FROM Project
JOIN Topic ON Project.topicId = Topic.id
JOIN Enrollment ON Enrollment.projectId = Project.id
WHERE Enrollment.grade > 90

SELECT *
FROM Articles
WHERE visualStorytelling IN ('Photo', 'Video')
  AND articleType = 'Technology'

SELECT name
FROM Psychologists
WHERE clinic = 'Harmony Wellness Center'
UNION
SELECT name
FROM Psychiatrists
WHERE clinic = 'Harmony Wellness Center'

SELECT FullName
FROM Customers
WHERE Digital_Solutions IN ('Mobile Banking App', 'Internet Banking Platform')
  AND Sign_in_Options = 'Biometric Authentication'

SELECT PassingMark
FROM Assessments
WHERE Assessor = 'Professor Smith'
  AND AssessmentMethod IN ('Exam', 'Quiz')

SELECT Books.Title
FROM Books
JOIN Publishers ON Books.PublisherID = Publishers.PublisherID
WHERE Publishers.Email = 'pearson@email.com'
  AND Books.Educational_Materials IN ('textbook', 'e-book')

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) / COUNT(t2.id)
FROM Player AS t1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2
  ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE t1.height > 170
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010'
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015'

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END), 0)
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT Patient.Diagnosis, Patient.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RBC < 3.5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.CPK < 250
  AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
  AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN event.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN budget.amount END) AS REAL) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN event.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN budget.amount END)
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE budget.category = 'Advertisement'
SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget

SELECT e.cost
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Posters'
  AND ev.event_name = 'September Speaker'

SELECT b.category
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
  AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND b.spent = 0

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations AS g
JOIN transactions_1k AS t
  ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2012-08-%'

SELECT DISTINCT t.Time
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.ChainID = 11

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID)
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'

SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, di.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(l.amount)
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) -
       (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card AS ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, SUM(a.element = 'o') AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)

SELECT printf('%.5f%%', 100.0 * SUM(bond_type = '=') / COUNT(bond_id)) AS percentage
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008'

SELECT CAST(SUM(atom.element = 'cl') AS REAL) / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
JOIN rulings AS r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'premodern'
  AND r.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c.side IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT s.name
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s
  ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT UserId
  FROM badges
  GROUP BY UserId
  HAVING COUNT(Name) > 5
)

SELECT 100.0 * (
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
) / COUNT(Name)
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Student'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f."CDSCode")
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
  ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."Charter" = 0
  AND f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18

SELECT p.Id
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'slashnick'
ORDER BY p.AnswerCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC

SELECT c.colour,
       COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(s.id) DESC) AS rank
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY superhero_count DESC

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  )

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg > (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) * 0.79 FROM superhero)

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength'
  )

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad'

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City

SELECT races.name
FROM results
JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND results.rank = (
    SELECT MIN(r2.rank)
    FROM results AS r2
    JOIN drivers AS d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId
    WHERE d2.forename = 'Lewis'
      AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton'
  )

SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date
LIMIT 1

SELECT code
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'American'

SELECT strftime('%Y', r.date) AS year,
       r.name,
       r.date,
       r.time
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE q.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ProjectName
FROM Development_Projects
WHERE ProjectName IN ('Airport Expansion', 'Renovation')
  AND Increased_Capacity = '1000 Passengers per Day'

SELECT Description
FROM Photos
WHERE SubjectID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Subjects
    WHERE Name = 'history'
)
UNION
SELECT Description
FROM Illustrations
WHERE SubjectID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Subjects
    WHERE Name = 'history'
)

SELECT af.name, fs.species_name
FROM Aquaculture_Facility AS af
JOIN Aquaculture_Facility_Fish_Species AS affs
  ON af.id = affs.aquaculture_facility_id
JOIN Fish_Species AS fs
  ON affs.fish_species_id = fs.id

SELECT r.routeName, rr.restrictionsType
FROM Routes AS r
JOIN Routes_Restrictions AS rr ON r.id = rr.routesId

SELECT s.price
FROM Real_Estate_Agencies AS rea
JOIN Real_Estate_Agencies_Services AS reas
  ON rea.agency_id = reas.real_estate_agency_id
JOIN Services AS s
  ON reas.service_id = s.service_id

SELECT c.name, i.description
FROM Community_Development_Corporations AS c
JOIN Community_Development_Corporations_Initiatives AS cdi
  ON c.id = cdi.community_development_corporation_id
JOIN Initiatives AS i
  ON cdi.initiative_id = i.id

SELECT Fleets.fleetName, Fleets.capacity
FROM Airlines
JOIN Airlines_Fleets ON Airlines.id = Airlines_Fleets.airlineId
JOIN Fleets ON Airlines_Fleets.fleetId = Fleets.id

SELECT dp.degree_program_id, dp.degree_summary_name
FROM Degree_Programs AS dp
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se
  ON dp.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id
GROUP BY dp.degree_program_id, dp.degree_summary_name
ORDER BY COUNT(se.student_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT PetType, AVG(weight) AS average_weight
FROM Pets
GROUP BY PetType

SELECT t.Template_Type_Code
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Templates AS t ON d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID
GROUP BY t.Template_Type_Code
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CountryCode)
FROM countrylanguage
WHERE Language IN ('English', 'Dutch')
GROUP BY CountryCode
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Language) = 2

SELECT Code, Name
FROM Products AS p
WHERE Price = (
  SELECT MIN(Price)
  FROM Products
  WHERE Manufacturer = p.Manufacturer
)

SELECT investor_id, AVG(share_count) AS avg_share_count
FROM Transactions
GROUP BY investor_id

SELECT avg_gradepoint
FROM enrolled_in_gradeconversion_student_gradepoint
WHERE lname = 'Smith'

SELECT HoursPerWeek, GamesPlayed
FROM SportsInfo
JOIN Student ON SportsInfo.StuID = Student.StuID
WHERE Fname = 'David' AND LName = 'Shieber'
SELECT AVG(Money_Requested) FROM entrepreneur
SELECT MAX(Points) FROM climber WHERE Country = 'United Kingdom'

SELECT avg_no_of_customers
FROM bank_no_of_customers

SELECT AVG(avg_total)
FROM body_builder_people_total
WHERE height > 200

SELECT AVG(d.access_count)
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Functional_Areas AS dfa
  ON d.document_code = dfa.document_code
JOIN Functional_Areas AS fa
  ON dfa.functional_area_code = fa.functional_area_code
WHERE fa.functional_area_description = 'Acknowledgement'

SELECT sum_amount_settled
FROM settlements_amount_settled

SELECT SUM(oi.Order_Quantity)
FROM Order_Items AS oi
JOIN Products AS p ON oi.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
WHERE p.Product_Name LIKE '%photo%'

SELECT max_followers, sum_followers
FROM user_profiles_followers

SELECT name
FROM Highschooler
WHERE ID NOT IN (
  SELECT student_id
  FROM Friend
)

SELECT employee_id, max_end_date
FROM job_history_end_date

SELECT SUM(oi.Order_Quantity)
FROM Order_Items AS oi
JOIN Products AS p ON oi.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
WHERE p.Product_Name = 'photo'

SELECT name, sex
FROM people_candidate_oppose_rate

SELECT avg_attendance
FROM performance_attendance

SELECT SUM(maxOccupancy)
FROM Rooms
WHERE decor = 'modern'

SELECT product_type_code, AVG(product_price) AS average_price
FROM Products
GROUP BY product_type_code
